title: Look up every named fact's scope
statement: Check every named fact in generated content against the unit, period and standard it must stay within with a lookup, since prompt warnings reduce out-of-scope facts but don't remove them.
example: A prompt block listing date traps cut out-of-period examples by about 30-50%, but did not remove them.
detail: A guide to passing the judge names a real but out-of-period example as the writer's most common failure across item types, and says a prompt block listing the common date traps reduces it by ~30-50% without eliminating it. On one topic the writer kept inserting such an event despite the chronology guardrail and never got above 0.78 in 22 tries. An adversarial report proposes a deterministic curriculum lookup that flags any named statute outside the period. Checking a named fact for truth alone is not enough: in one course's knowledge-schema tracker, a fact was removed as out of the course's time frame, significant events lost their mapping to a specific standard because they fit only the overall learning objective, and a true sentence was faulted for missing the heart of its topic.
against: None found. The lookup is proposed, not tested, and the ~30-50% cut is the guide's own estimate. The tally comes from keywords in free-text comments, not a coded field, so the categories overlap and placement leads repeats only narrowly. The comments cluster in three units (44, 31 and 44), so the mix reflects a few people's habits.

A deterministic curriculum-API lookup that flags any named statute outside the period would catch the rest.
